Class TuiInterface

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.ui.tui.TuiInterface
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView, UserInterface
public class TuiInterface extends Object implements UserInterface
This class implements the TUI (Text User Interface).
